help: Required existing boundary for all sources and targets. Blank disables planning and changes.
Allowed operations: copy, move, quarantine. Targets are never overwritten and parents must exist.
Time allowed to approve a plan. Approval must match its exact digest and revision.
Maximum explicit operations per plan. No recursive folder operations or wildcards.
Maximum retained plans in this block's ledger; no automatic deletion.
Bounded planning or apply duration; a partial apply produces an explicit receipt.
